HediffDef.label: the wrung
HediffDef.description: The press took water this body will never hold again. Thirst runs slower than it used to — the body learned to hold what little it has — but there is less blood to spare, healing comes slower, and a gauntness has settled in that will never leave. (The thirst-need benefit is flavor-true but not yet mechanically wired to any specific water/thirst mod — see the item file.)

HediffDef.label: salt-eyed
HediffDef.description: Weeks of the reservoir's brine in the eyes. The glare of the open desert does not touch them any more — but sight is permanently clouded.

HediffDef.label: the stillness
HediffDef.description: Learned the predator's arithmetic, waiting on the shore: everything comes back to the mouth eventually, so there is nothing left to panic about. Never breaks from fear or a bad mood the way others do — but cannot run, ever again.

HediffDef.label: the tithe
HediffDef.description: The body carries the dew ring's scent now, faint but permanent. Every appraising predator in the deep desert reads this pawn as full, and strikes it first. A cistern's roots are said to surface nearer to one who carries this — it wants them back.

HediffDef.label: the bloom
HediffDef.description: Anhydrobiotic spores lodged in the skin during the wringing. Harmless — but whenever this pawn gets wet, something briefly grows on them. Nobody who sees it forgets it.

HediffDef.label: pressed
HediffDef.description: A limb, or a ribcage, that the press flattened and released. Whatever could hurt there is gone for good, along with some of what that part could still do.

HediffDef.label: taken-and-returned
HediffDef.description: The tribes' word for one who came back from that place. What it means to them — sacred, or unclean, or both by holding — is theirs to decide, not this pawn's body. Mechanically this marks who they were taken by and nothing more.
